# `oaap app instance-keys`

the platform's keys of each instance (RFC-0062): renew those that expire soon, or clear orphans.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app instance-keys [--days DAYS] [--name NAME] [--dry-run]
                              [--quiet]
                              {renew,orphans}
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `--days DAYS` | renew what expires within this many days (default 30) |
| `--name NAME` | only this instance (its key) |
| `--dry-run` | say, change nothing |
| `--quiet` | say nothing when nothing is due (the nightly timer) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `renew` | yes |
| `orphans` | yes |
